entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From anywhere in the city of Montak..."
entries.dialogueText: From anywhere in the city of Montaklar, you could look high into the hills and see the ruins of Fortress Azaro.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""How do you like the view, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "How do you like the view, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Expanded and fortified over the cen..."
entries.dialogueText: Expanded and fortified over the centuries, it had served as a stronghold for the city's inhabitants from the early years of the Rezenid Empire until its destruction in the War of Rizian Succession.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Today, the ruins served as a symbol..."
entries.dialogueText: Today, the ruins served as a symbol of Montaklar's resilience - and that of its governing house. Perhaps that was why Lucita had invited me here for a tour and private talk.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For safety's sake, a wooden walkway..."
entries.dialogueText: For safety's sake, a wooden walkway had been constructed over the crumbling remains of the parapets. Lucita and I walked along it until we came to the northwestern corner.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From here, we could look down into..."
entries.dialogueText: From here, we could look down into the valley, where the provincial capital sprawled across the fast-flowing Alca river and up into the foothills of the mountains opposite us.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's fine. I always preferred the..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's fine. I always preferred the ocean over mountains, myself."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Spectacular. Why did you bring me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Spectacular. Why did you bring me here, Duchess Azaro?"

entries.dialogueText: "I remember it well from my military days."

entries.dialogueText: We had come to a small grassy patch in the shade of the fortress' southern wall. Lucita gestured for me to sit down.

entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, we heard the click of a c..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, we heard the click of a camera shutter. A news photographer had managed to get a photo of us from the opposite parapet.

entries.dialogueText: From below, a camera clicked. A news photographer had managed to reach the base of the fortress and capture a picture of us.

entries.dialogueText: "You are to find this photographer and prevent the publication of this picture at all costs."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not berate our staff, Duchess A..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Having said that...""
entries.dialogueText: "Having said that..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But with Lespia in ATO, and Morell..."
entries.dialogueText: "But with Lespia in ATO, and Morella becoming closer to Valgsland and the CSP... I do wonder whether our neighbor will get swallowed up in the superpower conflict."

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""With Lespia in ATO, and Morella be..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Lespia in ATO, and Morella becoming closer to Valgsland and the CSP, I do wonder whether our neighbor will get swallowed up in the superpower conflict."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's ridiculous. It's an inconse..."

entries.title: Narrator: "She blanched slightly."
entries.dialogueText: She blanched slightly.

entries.dialogueText: "My father belongs to a different generation. One that solves disputes with brute force, not subtlety."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So? How does that involve Rizia?""
entries.dialogueText: "So? How does that involve Rizia?"

entries.dialogueText: "The Wehlen Civil War happened before the development of nuclear weapons, Your Majesty. Today's superpower conflicts have the potential for far more wide-ranging damage."

entries.dialogueText: "I thought you'd be pleased with this decision. A completely centralized military means more troops under your direct command."

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Do you have reason to believe the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you have reason to believe the royal houses should not be entrusted with their own armies?"

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I believe certain houses can be tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe certain houses can be trusted and certain others can't. But it would have raised too much suspicion to remove the levies in only one province."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry, but the provincial armies w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, but the provincial armies were a potential threat to my power as King. They had to go."

entries.dialogueText: "Well, perhaps you're willing to discuss this."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I must tell you House Azaro wasn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must tell you House Azaro wasn't happy with this directive."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The Azaro army had a long, proud t..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Azaro army had a long, proud tradition of defending Rizia and its monarch. Their skill and dedication were unlike anything else in this kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And they will be just as skillfull..."
entries.dialogueText: "And they will be just as skillfull and dedicated serving directly under the Crown. Won't they?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Exactly. If such a formidable forc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly. If such a formidable force ever were to turn against their King, the consequences would be catastrophic."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's the problem. Your house was..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's the problem. Your house was making the rest of army look weak by comparison. Such greatness needs to be dispersed through the entire Armed Forces, not concentrated in one province."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She frowned reluctantly."
entries.dialogueText: She frowned reluctantly.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes. I'll see to that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. I'll see to that."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm disappointed you think that wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm disappointed you think that would even be a possibility, Your Majesty. Your father considered the Azaro special forces among his most valuable military assets."

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But you are not King Valero. I und..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She frowned in disappointment."
entries.dialogueText: She frowned in disappointment.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, and I am truly sad to see it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, and I am truly sad to see it go. But greater things are on the horizon for Rizia's armies. You'll see."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave a short laugh."
entries.dialogueText: She gave a short laugh.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That's very kind of you. I'll try..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's very kind of you. I'll try to convey that reasoning to my relatives."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And I hope you believe me when I s..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I hope you believe me when I say the Azaros will never pose a threat to you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Whatever you have in store, I hope..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you have in store, I hope I'll be the first to know."
